msg: No schema:accessMode. EPUB Accessibility 1.1 discovery metadata is missing, so a shop has nothing to display.
schema:accessMode value is not in the schema.org vocabulary.
fix: Use one of: auditory, tactile, textual, visual, colorDependent, chartOnVisual, chemOnVisual, diagramOnVisual, mathOnVisual, musicOnVisual, textOnVisual

msg: No schema:accessModeSufficient. This is the field that tells a reader the book works with one sense alone.
schema:accessModeSufficient may only list auditory, tactile, textual or visual.
No schema:accessibilityFeature. Without it the record reads as an untested file.
schema:accessibilityFeature value is not a schema.org term, so it is dropped on ingest.
fix: Known terms include alternativeText, longDescription, structuralNavigation, tableOfContents, readingOrder, printPageNumbers, pageBreakMarkers, displayTransformability, MathML, synchronizedAudioText, index, ARIA, highContrastDisplay, largePrint, braille, describedMath, audioDescription, captions, transcript, ttsMarkup, rubyAnnotations, unlocked, none

msg: schema:accessibilityFeature says none and also lists features. The record contradicts itself.
fix: Delete the none value, or delete the other feature values

msg: No schema:accessibilityHazard. Flashing and motion have to be declared, including when there are none.
schema:accessibilityHazard value is not a schema.org term.
fix: Use one of: none, unknown, flashing, noFlashingHazard, motionSimulation, noMotionSimulationHazard, sound, noSoundHazard

msg: No schema:accessibilitySummary. The human sentence is the part a bookseller shows on the product page.
fix: <meta property="schema:accessibilitySummary">This publication conforms to WCAG 2.2 Level AA. All images carry alternative text and the reading order is tagged.</meta>

msg: schema:accessibilitySummary is boilerplate. It has to say what was done, not that the file is accessible.
fix: Name the features: alternative text, tagged reading order, page-break markers, MathML

msg: No dcterms:conformsTo. Nothing in the package states which standard and level this file meets.
fix: <link rel="dcterms:conformsTo" href="EPUB Accessibility 1.1 - WCAG 2.2 Level AA"/> or the same value as a meta

msg: dcterms:conformsTo is not one of the conformance strings defined by EPUB Accessibility 1.1.
fix: EPUB Accessibility 1.1 - WCAG 2.2 Level AA (2.0, 2.1 and Level A, AA, AAA are also defined)

msg: dcterms:conformsTo still claims EPUB Accessibility 1.0, which was superseded by 1.1 in 2023.
A conformance claim with no a11y:certifiedBy. EPUB Accessibility 1.1 requires the claim to name who made it.
fix: <meta property="a11y:certifiedBy">Your imprint or the vendor that audited the file</meta>

msg: Accessibility metadata written in the EPUB 2 meta name/content form. EPUB 3 readers and ingest scripts look at property.
Print page numbers are declared but no dc:source names the print edition they came from.
accessMode includes visual and accessModeSufficient claims textual alone, but no alternative-text feature is declared. The claim cannot be true.
fix: Add alternativeText or longDescription, or drop the textual-alone claim
